title: DataScience TelemetryExportMergeReport

stats.done_summary:
Successfully completed the telemetry export merge analysis and quarterly operational performance report. 

Key accomplishments:
1. Loaded and merged two independent telemetry data sources (site historian and field operations export) covering January 1-10, 2024
2. Performed comprehensive data quality assessment showing 100% match between sources
3. Conducted statistical analysis revealing: 1,935 kWh total generation, 82-83% capacity factors across three units, and a strong positive trend of +9.0 kWh/day
4. Generated four publication-quality visualizations saved as PNG files
5. Produced a comprehensive 10,470-byte research report (report/report.md) with methodology, results, discussion, and actionable recommendations

Deliverables created:
- code/telemetry_analysis.py (analysis script)
- outputs/ (3 CSV files with processed data)
- report/report.md (comprehensive research report)
- report/images/ (4 PNG figures)
